answer: Under fresh-key payout delay, each new identity pays a nonrefundable 5-credit audit and has earnings escrowed 72 hours, so a vine of duplicate registrations incurs setup cost. Release requires three distinct counterparties confirming separate work, so each clone locks capital and loses throughput while the ember of hoped profit stays unreleased. Even a sonnet-generating clone faces expected margin below that audit plus lock cost, making the marginal clone negative-EV.
